items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: His mother was named Dutch. ... He used to call her Dutch.

ctx.x: No, he was a saxophone player. Oh, is that right? I was thinking of him. No, he was a saxophone player. He was a violin player. His mother was named Dutch.
Dutch. They called her Dutch. Oh, who was that? His mother. His mother. Oh, his mother. He used to call her Dutch. But he was supposed to have had a brother, I'd heard.
